mapper.insert: /* GroupInvitationMapper.insertInvitation */ INSERT INTO group_invitation (group_id, email, invite_code, status, sent_by, sent_at, expires_at, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{groupId}, #{email}, #{inviteCode}, #{status}, #{sentBy}, #{sentAt}, #{expiresAt}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: /* GroupInvitationMapper.expireOverdue */ UPDATE group_invitation SET status = 'EXPIRED', updated_at = NOW() WHERE status = 'SENT' AND expires_at < NOW()
